title: Build fn-tests-j1

proofs.run: sh -c 'WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR=$D/results WHOOSH_THEME=light python3 journeys/run.py J1 2>&1 ; cat "$D/results"/J1-*.results.jsonl'
proofs.pass: (?s)J1 GREEN: 12 steps, \d+ checks, 0 failed, 0 not judged.*"step": "J1.1", "case": "theme-applied", "verdict": "PASS"

proofs.run: sh -c 'WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR=$D/results WHOOSH_THEME=dark python3 journeys/run.py J1 2>&1 ; cat "$D/results"/J1-*.results.jsonl'
proofs.pass: (?s)J1 GREEN: 12 steps, \d+ checks, 0 failed, 0 not judged.*"step": "J1.1", "case": "theme-applied", "verdict": "PASS"
J1 selftest: \d+ checks, \d+ mutants, 0 not red or missing
proofs.fail: NO MUTANT|STRAY|NOT IN THE CATALOGUE|[1-9]\d* not red or missing

notes: J1 prints its verdict line on stderr from journeys/run.py:54 ('%s %s: %d steps, %d checks, %d failed, %d not judged: %s'), so a pass reads 'J1 GREEN: 12 steps, 87 checks, 0 failed, 0 not judged: all 87 checks passed' (journeys/lib/harness.py:360). The acceptance's '12 checks' is the 12 steps J1.1-J1.12 (journeys/J1.py has 12 j.step calls; the last saved run counted 87 checks in 12 steps); the totals line on stdout is 'N checks, 0 failed, 0 not judged' (run.py:67). One launch per theme: WHOOSH_THEME=light|dark (J1.py:5, 97, 257-258); the proof runs them as two hidden proofs, each wrapped in sh -c so the harness's per-case jsonl (journeys/lib/harness.py:248-270, WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR) is printed as well and a pass is a PASS line per case, not only an absence of FAIL. The runner must not pass 2>&1 twice. 'Before slice 1 lands, exit 1' is history: saved red runs _captures/tests-j1/J1-live-light.txt:4 and J1-live-dark.txt:4 (26 failed, 21 not judged); it cannot be re-run on this build, so it is not a proof here. Proofs 2 and 3 are the mutant half: checks/mutant-coverage-check.py:20-40 (every check names a mutant, exit 0, dry, no app; it covers all journeys, so it also covers every slice-1 check) and journeys/J1.py:540-560 (selftest, dry). The state is prove because every piece exists; whether J1 is green on this build is what proofs 0 and 1 will say (the saved run was red). J1.6 one-interaction-budget-ms (J1.py:331-339) and J1.1 launch-budget-ms are load-sensitive: they are judged only on a quiet machine (under_load). Mutant: the app reports the theme it was asked for (Sources/ControlSocket/Verbs.swift:59, uistate theme = WindowControl.theme); forcing 'light' must turn the dark proof red on theme-applied (J1.py:258; mutant row J1.py:448). It needs an app rebuild.
